address: 1d St James's Street, Kemptown, Brighton and Hove, BN2 1RE, United Kingdom
bio: In the day, this is the Redroaster coffee shop; in the evening, it morphs into a thriving Thai restaurant with a contented crackle in the air. Sit at the large counter or along the long wall of banquettes, surrounded by foliage that adds to the bright, airy feel. Northern Thai barbecue is the main influence behind the menu and there are fresh, clean flavours in abundance. The famous drunken noodles are a highlight, coming with crispy deep-fried pork or succulent chicken. The prices are keen and the portions are generous, so come with friends and a hearty appetite....
